request.subject: UNIT:GOBLIN:CATAPULT

layers.text: Recolour only: the cart's orange planks and wheels become dull desaturated dark brown wood, colour #5c3a22 with #3a2414 shadows; the goblin's bright green skin becomes olive green #8a952f with #495508 shadows; his orange cap becomes dull brown leather #955627. He holds the match close to his chest so nothing reaches past the cart's right side. Keep everything else exactly the same: his face, the five paper rockets, sticks, rope, fuse spark, thick black outline and art style.
